purpose: Gate the concrete-object LLM judged-modulation study BEFORE any evidence judging: ensure a win reflects object-function modulation-fit, not prose/style/denotation/quality advantage in A_real.
stimulus_format: Within the fixed meaning, this object is modulated by [tag1], [tag2], [tag3], and [tag4].

checks: same number of tags (4) in every arm

style_tell_audit.procedure: an auditor (or LLM style-tell judge) attempts to identify which option is A_real from surface style alone, arm labels hidden
style_tell_audit.metric: balanced identification accuracy of A_real from style
style_tell_audit.fail_rule: if A_real identifiable above threshold by style -> STOP or revise GLOBALLY before evidence judging
style_tell_audit.note: DRAFT threshold, revisable until explicit EVIDENCE_FREEZE

leakage_checks.fail_rule: any leakage -> global fix or exclusion before freeze

quality_parity_checks.rationale: controls must be plausible, not straw men; a degraded control would manufacture a false A_real win

pass_fail_rules.on_fail: STOP or global template-level revision; NO per-item hand rescue; re-audit before proceeding

order_of_operations: 2. render stimuli in the fixed 4-tag format
3. run style_parity + style_tell + denotation_leakage + quality_parity audits
4. only if ALL pass (and after EVIDENCE_FREEZE) -> proceed to evidence judging
5. any fail -> global fix, re-audit; never per-item rescue
